messages:
neha: noticing a pattern where remediation tickets stall after PMs. quick proposal: lightweight 3-point followup + small escalation rules. want to pilot for 4 weeks.

cal: curious what the 3 points are.

neha: 1) quick assign + SLO (P1=14d/P2=30d/P3=90d) at PM close. 2) short checkpoints (24h, 72h, 14d) logged in the ticket. 3) recurrence detection if same service shows up twice in 60d -> flag for review.

morgan: add required acceptance criteria for every remediation. otherwise "done" is vague. also suggest tiny structured checkpoint entries so reviewers can scan quickly.

neha: agreed. sample checkpoint snippet: `24h: owner / status / blockers / next action (ETA)` — single line entries.

ops-bot: i can schedule nudge messages: `@ops-bot schedule-ticket <ticket-id> 24h 72h 14d notify:owner,oncall-lead`. needs jira hookup.

cal: escalation rule idea: if owner marks blocked twice -> auto-escalate to oncall-lead and create an unblock ticket. saves manual pinging.

oncall-lead: small tweak on rotation: 2-week IC slots starting Monday 09:00 UTC. shorter slots split context. secondary covers weekends. roster visible in playbook.

morgan: metrics: track remediations reopened rate and repeat-service count (60d). if repeat-service >= 3 -> trigger a focused RCA and tag platform.

neha: process tie-ins: require that PM writer suggests an owner + acceptance criteria at postmortem publishing. i'll draft a PR that includes a tiny ticket template, ops-bot commands, and the two-week rotation.

cal: happy to help test ops-bot flow.

ops-bot: tip: use `@ops-bot preview-ticket <ticket-id>` to see scheduled reminders without sending.

neha: plan: i'll open PR today, ask for reviews from oncall leads. if no objections in 48h we start a 4-week pilot. goal: fewer orphaned remediations and faster detection of repeating components. :thumbsup:

morgan: sounds good.

oncall-lead: i'll run the pilot and schedule a 30-min retro at the end of 4 weeks.

neha: thanks all — short checkpoints + clear SLOs should make followups less leaky.
